questions.title: What makes a local feedback loop trustworthy?
questions.description: Can a mathematical agent inspect the exact local state produced by an action, test the relevant consequence, and preserve the result as evidence about that action?

links.why: makes local state and diagnostics inspectable
proposes learning from structured action consequences; training results remain open

questions.title: How should unfinished mathematical work be represented?

links.why: separates candidate activity from verification; no repository contribution claimed
separates canonical records and derived views

questions.title: When does persistent state become inherited research rather than a larger context window?

links.why: shared activity alone does not establish inheritance

questions.title: What does replaceability require?

questions.title: How can a research system learn from failures without flattening evidence?
